nom: ROSEN Break-Out Spot Treatment for Large Bumps and Breakouts

avis.texte: The first time i purchased it was great at first. Helpful in reducing the size of closed comedones. But that effectiveness didn't last the full 12 months I had before the product expired. It is almost like once you open it the effectiveness slowly goes away. The packahing is also bad. You can only bring the spoolie in and out, no rotation if you need more product. You will be leaving product in the bottle by the end of its use. It also is a complicated wash-off in the morning. I'm on my second bottle and it just doesn't seem to work at all. Results are inconsistent. I won't repurchase.
This does absolutly nothing to help my pimples and has a really strong scent. I could get past the scent if it actually worked, but it didnt.

Obviously, this product doesn't magically make your pimples disappear overnight. However, I've noticed that it makes my deep cystic acne spots less painful and less likely to come to a head, and my smaller pimples resolve quicker. I like that the thick formula acts a protective barrier between my pimple and the outside world. Because it dries out into a powdery shell, it dries out your pimples and makes them less likely to pop if you brush your hand against them on accident or something like that. I like that the formula is simple and science-backed to fight acne (other than the ACV, which I assume is just a way to balance pH while seeming trendy). Overall I really like the product and find it helpful and easy to use.
Absolutely worhh th it. Helps wirh dark spots and uneven tone.

Minimized breakouts overnight for me. No irritation. I have never had an acne spot treatment be this potent/worked so fast. I also find the minty consistency refreshing with a quick dry dish so no mess. Telling you now will not be buying any other spot treatment. Best discovery this year for brands would be Rosen. Really caters to melanin girlies and the delicate balance of need of efficacy but still gentleness. Bought more products. This brand is my new go to!

1. *Fast-acting*: This spot treatment starts working quickly to reduce redness and inflammation. 2. *Effective*: Salicylic acid and tea tree oil help to dry out pimples and prevent future breakouts. 3. *Easy to apply*: The treatment comes in a convenient, portable tube that's easy to apply directly to individual pimples. ## What I Love: 1. *Reduces inflammation*: The treatment helps to reduce redness and swelling, making pimples less noticeable. 2. *Dries out pimples fast*: The salicylic acid helps to dry out pimples quickly, promoting faster healing. 3. *Gentle on skin*: Despite its potency, the treatment is gentle on skin and doesn't cause irritation.

I think my skin really agrees with the ingredients here, and I will absolutely continue to use this.

avis.titre: Clearest skin since I was on tret
avis.texte: I bought this about a month ago and I love it. I have very oily skin that is acne prone and I get hormonal acne on my chin before my period. I was previously on tret, but my insurance changed and they were no longer covered. I tried a couple of other OTC options, but they didn't help. Then I tried this and my skin is the clearest it's ever been without a prescription. I cleanse my face before bed and apply this to any spots overnight. It doesn't tingle for me and I don't find the peppermint to be strong, in fact I forget it's on until I look in a mirror. Sometimes it rubs off during the night (I'm a side sleeper), but it still works. The spots are either reduced or have come to a head after one night, and after two nights, they're more or less gone. I like to feel my face for any zits that are starting but I can't see yet to tackle them before they even appear. I'm really amazed at how well it works and I definitely recommend it at least for skin types like mine!
Hands down the best spot treatment I've ever used. Doesn't dry out or irrate my skin-spots are minimized or gone overnight. Do not hesitate!
